notes.title: Maintenance & Contents Update Schedule - 07/10/2014
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We have an extensive balance update as well as a new character class update scheduled today.

Maintenance Schedule: 
July 10 03:00 PST – July 10 04:30 PST

Please refer to below patch notes for details of the update.

Contents Updates
- Rose, the Rocket Trooper joins the battlefield.
Rose is an extraordinary teenager from Iron Legion who likes rocket, explosion, and teddy bear. She uses rocket launcher from distance and shotgun in close combat. She is a powerful ranged fighter but she may struggle in melee fights.

- Steam friend list is available in GunZ 2 now.

Your Steam buddies will now appear on your friend list in game.
You can easily invite your friends into your game now.

- Added Daily Mission feature

You will be given 3 random missions every day.
Complete each mission to get rewards.
You can view your daily missions in Achievements menu.

- Fixed clan name bug which made it impossible to use the same clan name after deleting. The same clan name can be used 1 week after deleting the clan.

- EXP requirement for reaching level 20 has been reduced to half.
- 20% Discount Sale Event!
To celebrate introduction of Rose, we will continue the sale event until next weekend (July 20)

Balance Updates: Common changes

Default armor set’s total AP value has been increased from 60 to 85.
You can now use Aerial Dodge when struck by launch attack while you’re in mid-air.
Changes on ZP acquisition:

Amount of ZP gained from incoming damage is now based on any damage type whereas you only gained ZP from damage on HP previously.
(ZP gain from damage on HP -> ZP gain from any damage taken)
Amount of ZP you get from successful critical hit has been reduced by half.
Amount of ZP you get from consecutive kills has been reduced.
Amount of ZP you get from multi-kill has been reduced.
You now get ZP from at last strike of your combo attack whereas you previously gained ZP every 5th successful hit. (regardless of melee or ranged combo)
(ZP gain from every 5th hit -> ZP gain from last hit of a combo attack)
You no longer gain ZP from launch attack.
You now gain ZP when assisting a kill. ZP amount from kill assist is half of ZP gain from a Kill.

Character motion length of damage from grenade launcher has been reduced by half. You now can quickly get back to the battle after being hit by grenade explosion.


Balance Updates: Class specific changes
- Ivan

Duration of invincibility after casting Cyclone kick reduced from 0.5 to 0.2 seconds.
Bonus damage ratio of regular melee combo has been slightly reduced.
Bonus damage ratio of launch attack combo (MLB>MLB>MLB>MRB) has been slightly increased.


- Rena

Last attack of Rena’s regular combo now penetrates all type of defense including shield.
Critical chance bonus of Honed Razor has been increased from 10% to 20%.
Bonus damage ratio of melee attack and combo attack has been slightly increased.
Bonus damage ratio of launch attack has been reduced from 1.5 to 1.0.
Cooldown time of Shadow Decoy has been decreased from 6.5 to 5.5 seconds.
Shadow Rush now has 1 second super armor effect when casted.
Aim rate bonus of right clicking when dual pistol is equipped has been increased from 30% to 40% but it does not zoom in any more.


- Elena

Enemy detection duration of Intuition has been increased by 1 second.


- Max

Max now puts his weapons on his back when wall-running.
- Max runs faster when wall-running with flame-thrower or minigun. However, he falls from the wall if he attacks with them.
Enemies hit by dash-jump attack now bounces off the ground instead of being knocked down on the ground.
Increased level of super armor when firing minigun from 1 to 2. Sniper rifle or grenade launcher does not stop him from firing minigun any more.
Duration of Shield Rush’s super armor status has been increased from 0.5 to 1.0 second.


- Wayne

Enemies grabbed by Wayne’s whip then attacked by jump grab or Black now takes appropriate damage motion
Aiming radius of One Shot One Kill skill has been increased. Total length of aiming is also reduced from 2 to 1.5 seconds.
Black Snake now has super armor effect for 1 second.
Revolver’s effective range of damage has been increased.
Overall Damage per Second of lever action rifle has been increased but reload time has been slightly increased. 
Effective range of damage of all lever action rifle except for Defender 808 series has been reduced.
Ammo clip size of Rapid Shooter series has been reduced from 6 to 5.
Rapid Shooter series’ aiming rate now decreased when shooting continuously.



The game servers will be closed during the maintenance. 
We’re sorry about the down-time and will do our best to reopen the game servers as soon as possible. 

- GunZ Team

notes.title: Update 1.0 : Wayne the Strider
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have a maintenance schedule today.
Maintenance Schedule: 
April 30 02:00 PST – April 30 05:00 PST

Scheduled Tasks:

A new character, Wayne the Strider joins the battle.. New set of items for Strider are also added.
A new map, Gustav Hangar is now available. Campaign mode map, The Beast of Steel, was used to recreate this new PvP map.
All accessory items in Shop will be provided at 50% reduced price permanently. They can also be purchased with Gold now.
Tesla shop updates

New accessory items (times ones) are added to costume packages. (removed green armor items instead)
Weapon packages now only include weapon items of the same character class.

Update on Weekly 50% Discount
Discount on sunglasses is over, and following items will be on sale

Small Fairy Wings, Small Angel Wings, War Banner, Alexsei Backpack, Angry Alexsei Backpack
Weekly Discount does not affect gold prices of the sale items.

A few particular areas of Abandoned Mansion map were advantageous to a certain character class. We have restricted the area in this patch.
We’re holding a new weekly MVP event.
(10 competitors per each group, Thunder Badge will rewarded to the top player of each group)
There was a bug where players could bypass the second target destructible object in Time Assault mode. We fixed the bug and now it cannot be bypassed.
1v1 match of Team Elimination and Gladiator matches now requires 5 rounds won for winning the match. For Team Deathmatch, it requires 70 points to win.
[strike]Custom game is back![/strike]
New game mode, Practice Mode, is now available. Practice Mode is a custom game type of match that does not provide any match reward.



The game servers will be closed during the maintenance. 
We’re sorry about the down-time and will do our best to reopen the game servers as soon as possible.


As of today, we are releasing our game out of Early Access phase. First of all, we would like to thank you all again for supporting us from the very beginning.
There have been ups and downs for the past two and a half month since the launch of early access. Starting with the beta launch hiccup such as the notorious server capability issue, a number of problems such as network issue, hacker situation, optimization problems, and so forth have occurred. At the same time, we also have made significant changes and improvements to the game, although some of you may still disagree. :-P
I’d like to say that today’s official release is just an opening of a new chapter of GunZ 2. We will keep putting everything we can offer into the game for constant improvements. Starting with introduction of Strider, we will continue to add more exciting contents to keep you entertained.
Some of you have been with us for the past few years from GunZ 1. Some of you have joined the community with Steam release. As a small token of gratitude for supporting us from the beginning, we are providing each of you an Early Access Badge. You won’t be able to get the item from any other chance, so I suggest you to hold onto it. :)

Also, we will provide all in-game items at 20% discount price for 1 week to celebrate the official release.

Again, thank you very much, and have a great time in the new chapter of GunZ 2.

- GunZ Team

notes.title: Status Update - Server Issues (RESOLVED)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are having issues with game database at the moment.
Since the last maintenance, database performance has been unstable.

The issue is mostly found on servers for Korea, SEA, and Japan.
However, servers for other regions are also affected in lighter manner.

Due to this issue, you may see "Failed to create battle" error during match making process.

We are doing everything we can to address the problem as soon as possible.
We are very sorry about the instability of game service.

Please expect 2 hours for the service to be stable once again.

Sorry about the inconvenience.
- GunZ Team

* EDIT 2014-02-20 05:20 PST
The above DB issue has been resolved.
You won't be seeing "Failed to create battle" error while match making anymore.
However, to make sure that the issue does not occur again, we are planning to conduct another DB related maintenance within the next few ours.
Please note that game service will be stable and normal until then.

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Status update at Feb 19 2014 19:00 PST

Hello everyone,

I have good news to share with you.
As of now, we increased the max. server capacity to 4,500.
We will gradually increase this to host more and more players.

Also, since the last patch, there was an issue where new players received 100,000 gold at the beginning.
As this was not an intended change, we changed it back to 0 gold.

There will be another batch compensation item reward giveaway for the connection issue and starting gold issue.
We will send out in-game mail with the reward during the next maintenance.

- GunZ Team

notes.title: Status Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We're experiencing several issues at the moment.
Currently known issues are:
- Lag issue
   - frame lag on game lobby and title screen
   - match not starting promptly (FIXED)

Due to unexpected number of players that came in right at the launch hour, we had to increase server capacity.
However, our current server set-up could not serve all 4,000 players at once.
Thus, we decided to decrease server capacity (Max player limit) again to provide smooth game play for limited number of players for now.
The game server can host up to 1,500 players at the moment.

We will install and add more servers soon to host more players after securing server performance.

We are also working on the game client to address the frame lag issue.
There will be a client patch for this within the next few hours.

Sorry about all the launch day madness.
We'll make sure to stabilize the game service as soon as possible.

GunZ Team
